fullPassage:
In many sports, people realized the difficulties and even impossibilities of young children participating fully in many adult sport environments.

(A) As examples, baseball has T ball, football has flag football and junior soccer uses a smaller and lighter ball and (sometimes) a smaller field. All have junior competitive structures where children play for shorter time periods and often in smaller teams.

(B) In a similar way, tennis has adapted the court areas, balls and rackets to make them more appropriate for children under 10. The adaptations are progressive and relate to the age of the child.

(C) They found the road to success for young children is unlikely if they play on adult fields, courts or arenas with equipment that is too large, too heavy or too fast for them to handle while trying to compete in adult-style competition. Common sense has prevailed: different sports have made adaptations for children.

questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 field의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) field=참가자들(경쟁에 참가한 전체 집단), (B) field=들판(농경지)
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 참가자들 — (B) 들판: (A)에서 field는 마라톤 참가자 전체를 의미하고, (B)에서 field는 농부가 옥수수를 심는 농경지를 의미 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 경기장 — (B) 분야: (A)는 장소가 아닌 사람들, (B)는 학문 분야가 아닌 실제 땅
❌ ③ (A) 들판 — (B) 참가자들: 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ④ (A) 분야 — (B) 경기장: 두 문맥 모두 부적절
det.tip: field: 참가자들(경쟁 집단) / 들판(농경지) / 분야 / 경기장 등 다의어

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"changes made to something to make it suitable for a new purpose or situation"

det.korean: 새로운 목적이나 상황에 맞게 변경한 것 → adaptations(적응/변형)
det.analysis:
❌ ① competitions — 경쟁은 '새 목적에 맞게 변경'이라는 정의와 불일치
✅ ② adaptations — '새 목적이나 상황에 맞게 변경한 것'이라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ environments — 환경은 변경이라는 정의와 불일치
❌ ④ structures — 구조는 변경이라는 정의와 불일치
det.tip: adaptations = changes made to suit a new purpose/situation

questions.passage: They found the road to success for young children is unlikely if they play on adult fields, courts or arenas with equipment that is too large, too heavy or too fast for them to __________ (hand) while trying to compete in adult-style competition.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: hand → handle: 'for them to handle'에서 to부정사 뒤 동사원형 handle
det.analysis: ✅ 정답: handle — 'too fast for them to _____(hand)'에서 to부정사 뒤에 동사원형이 필요하며, hand의 변형인 handle(다루다)이 문맥에 적합
det.tip: hand → handle (다루다, 처리하다)

questions.passage: They found the road to success for young children is unlikely if they play on adult fields, courts or arenas with equipment that is too large, too heavy or too fast for them to handle while __________ (try) to compete in adult-style competition.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: try → trying: while 접속사 뒤에 현재분사 필요. while trying to compete
det.analysis: ✅ 정답: trying — 'while _____(try) to compete'에서 while 뒤에 현재분사(동시동작) 필요. try → trying
det.tip: try → trying (while + 현재분사 = 동시동작)

questions.passage:
In many sports, people realized the difficulties and even impossibilities of young children participating fully in many adult sport environments.

As examples, baseball has T ball, football has flag football and junior soccer uses a smaller and lighter ball and (sometimes) a smaller field. All have junior competitive structures where children play for shorter time periods and often in smaller teams.

In a similar way, tennis has adapted the court areas, balls and rackets to make them more appropriate for children under 10. The adaptations are progressive and relate to the age of the child.

They found __________ for young children is unlikely if they play on adult fields, courts or arenas with equipment that is too large, too heavy or too fast for them to handle while trying to compete in adult-style competition. Common sense has prevailed: different sports have made adaptations for children.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 어린이들이 성인 경기장에서 뛸 경우 '성공으로 가는 길(the road to success)'이 불가능하다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① the path to failure — '실패로 가는 길이 unlikely'하면 성공한다는 뜻이 되어 맥락과 모순
❌ ② the key to happiness — 행복의 열쇠는 스포츠 적응 맥락과 무관
❌ ③ the way to confusion — 혼란으로 가는 길은 맥락과 불일치
✅ ④ the road to success — 원문 일치. 성공으로 가는 길이 가능성이 낮다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: the road to success for young children is unlikely — 성공의 길이 가능성 낮음

det.korean: 어린이들이 성인 경기장에서 너무 크고 무거운 장비로 '성인 방식의 경쟁(adult-style competition)'을 하려 한다는 맥락
